problems.title: 3 Costly Problems Retailers Face Every Day

item1.title: Forgotten Customer Credit & Debts
item1.problem: Paper ledgers get lost, handwritten notes fade away, and customer debts remain unpaid.
item1.solution: Every customer has a dedicated digital profile showing their exact balance and complete transaction history.

item2.title: Slow Checkout During Rush Hours
item2.problem: Mental math or pocket calculators create long queues and change calculation mistakes.
item2.solution: Scan barcodes or tap touch shortcuts: totals and change due are calculated instantly.

item3.title: Lengthy & Stressful Evening Cash Audits
item3.problem: Spending 45 minutes counting bills without knowing if money is missing in the till.
item3.solution: A guided 3-minute Z-closure that calculates expected cash and flags any discrepancy immediately.

q1.q: How is Utopia installed on my computer?
q1.a: Utopia is a native desktop application built for Windows 10 and 11 (64-bit). Simply download the installer (173 MB) and run it: setup takes under 2 minutes.

q2.q: Does Utopia require an Internet connection to work?
q2.a: No. Utopia operates 100% offline. Your sales, stock, and customer accounts are managed locally on your computer with zero internet dependence.

q3.q: Where is my store data stored?
q3.a: All your business data stays locally on your PC inside your store. No commercial data is sent to external cloud servers.

q4.a: The software and web application support multiple international languages including English, French, Turkish, German, Spanish, Italian, and Arabic with native RTL layout.

q5.q: Which hardware peripherals can I connect to Utopia?
q5.a: Utopia is compatible with standard USB barcode scanners, touchscreens, cash drawers, and standard thermal receipt printers (80mm and 58mm).

q6.q: How does technical support and onboarding work?
q6.a: The StellarSoft team assists you directly via WhatsApp to guide your first startup and answer any questions.
